item.title: FHSAA releases new class 1A Districts as Rural Class is eliminated
item.description: With the Florida High School Athletic Association (FHSAA) eliminating the Rural Class and merging those programs into Class 1A, officials have released new district assignments for the 2026 and 2027 football seasons. item.title: ‘Missy’s Law’ advances in Senate
item.description: A bill that would require people convicted of certain dangerous crimes to be immediately taken into custody unanimously passed the Senate Appropriations Committee on Criminal and Civil Justice on Wednesday.
